# Quick Clean

> Quick Clean is a professional residential and commercial cleaning company serving Dubai, Sharjah and Ajman. We provide vetted, insured cleaners, flat upfront pricing, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Customers book a clean online in about 60 seconds.

## Key facts
- Name: Quick Clean
- Industry: House cleaning / maid service / commercial cleaning
- Rating: 4.9 out of 5 stars from 2,300+ verified customers
- Guarantee: 100% Spotless Guarantee — free re-clean within 24 hours if you are not satisfied
- Pricing model: flat, upfront, shown before booking — no hourly meters, no surprise fees, no contracts
- Cleaners: interviewed, background-checked, trained, fully insured and bonded

## Frequently asked questions
- Do I need to be home during the clean? No — most customers provide secure access instructions and come home to a spotless space.
- What if I am not satisfied? Tell us within 24 hours and we re-clean the area free (100% Spotless Guarantee).
- Are cleaners insured and background-checked? Yes — every cleaner is background-checked, trained, insured, and bonded.
- Do you bring supplies? Yes — eco-friendly professional products and equipment are included.
- How and when do I pay? Securely online by credit or debit card after the clean, only when you are happy.
- How much does cleaning cost? Standard from AED 99, deep from AED 179, move-out from AED 189; exact flat rate shown before booking.
- How long does a house cleaning take? A standard clean takes about 1.5 to 3 hours; deep and move-out cleans take longer.
- Can I book a same-day or next-day clean? Yes — same-day and next-day slots are often available, booked online in about 60 seconds.
- What types of properties do you clean? Apartments, villas, townhouses, studios, offices, and commercial spaces.
- What is the difference between a standard and deep clean? A standard clean maintains a tidy home; a deep clean adds baseboards, grout, vents, and inside/behind appliances.
- How often should I clean? Most choose bi-weekly; weekly for homes with kids or pets; monthly for lighter homes. Recurring plans save up to 20%.
- Are your products safe for kids and pets? Yes — professional, eco-friendly, non-toxic products.
- Can I get the same cleaner every time? Yes, on recurring plans.
- Can I reschedule or cancel? Yes — no contracts and no cancellation fees.
- What if something is damaged? Quick Clean is fully insured and bonded; report within 24 hours and we make it right.
- Do you offer office or commercial cleaning? Yes — custom after-hours recurring plans; request a free walkthrough.
